newsitem.title: CROATIA: Police make largest ever drug seizure in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Police make largest ever drug seizure in Croatia.

text.p: Police and customs officers made the largest ever drug seizure in Croatia when they discovered 150 kilos (330 lb) of cocaine in the port of Rijeka on Saturday, state radio said.
It quoted a police spokesman as saying the drug, with a street value of about $8 million, was covered with fabric inside a container.

The spokesman said the cocaine originated in Ecuador and was destined for Western European markets. There were strong indications that Croatian citizens belonged to an international chain of drug smugglers, the radio said.
